T: The long-term score has increased by 3.7 points due to the price reaching new cycle highs and the strengthening market regime. Conviction has increased by 2.3 points as the technical strength now outweighs the persistent fundamental concerns in the long-term view. Risk has decreased by 2.6 points, primarily driven by the strong price momentum and the robust market regime, which mitigate the impact of the underlying balance sheet stress in the current bullish environment.
